title: Instruction instance and semantics
statement: An instruction instance consists of an operation and a legal operand form. Its semantics is a total relation from an input state to either a normal output state or a named trapped outcome. A deterministic, non-trapping slice may be represented by a function only after those restrictions are declared.

formal.statement: sem : InstructionInstance -> State w -> Outcome (State w)

notes: This definition deliberately avoids pretending that every real ISA instruction is a total state-to-state function without an outcome type.
